adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~2-day drop (518–520) in all axes, followed by a return to pre-event levels by ~522; P2 (521–531) overlaps the recovery phase and lacks a distinct opposing return—its onset offset is nearly identical to P1’s, suggesting it’s part of the same transient event. The residual plots confirm that subtracting only P1 (Hypothesis P1) restores smooth motion across all axes, while subtracting P2 (P2) leaves a residual step at ~522. No independent platform exists for P2; the interior of P2 shows no persistent offset—only recovery and ongoing physical motion. Thus only P1 is a genuine temporary platform.
